label: c/i/3/x input late in long sequences (last original positions or first copy step)
explanation: Fires when the input token is one of a small set (mainly c and i, then 3 and x, more weakly y/h/0) and the absolute step is late, about t=7..11, which only happens in long sequences (L>=7; 62% of mass at L=9). Two contexts carry nearly all mass: the last original positions (orig_idx 7-8, ~39%) and the first copy step, recall_idx 1, whose input is the fed-back orig(0) (~50%), plus some at recall_idx 2. It never fires at t<=5, on the <DEL> step, or for L<=4, and almost never at recall_idx>=3. The largest activations (top quartile, ~0.9 coverage) are c or i fed back at the first copy step of L=9 sequences, or i at the last original position. Precision is limited: the same tokens at these positions often do not fire, and low-magnitude activations also show up on other tokens at the same times, so token identity times late timing is only a partial description.
